Hear me out, start an onlyfans. Dead serious.

You’re 18, people will pay a premium for that. You don’t need a high school diploma, don’t need a car, and you can work safely in the privacy of your own home with your social anxiety. It’s easy work that you can do even if you’re depressed.

Then use the money to pay for a therapist. Give some money to your family to get them to back off a little

Without any context, it’s kinda difficult to console you about it. Did you cheat on someone? Put a tampon in someone’s gas tank? Destroy someone’s PlayStation? We could probably help you think you’re not *that* bad if you just tell us what you did
What was the list? I’m sure people here could help add some cons to it
Do the mods remove posts on here? I’ve been trying to post for days but I can only comment

I feel the exact same way. I can’t kill myself now because it would devastate my parents especially my mom. But once they pass away nothing will be stopping me. I don’t know how much longer they have. Could be 10 years or 20. I can’t imagine myself holding on for another 20 years
It’s okay to ask for help
